newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Klaus van der Pas said Commission President Jacques Santer had sent a telegram of congratulations to incoming British Prime Minister Tony Blair, whose Labour Party won a landslide victory in Thursday's general election.
He said a date had not yet been set for Santer and Blair to meet.
Responding to a question on International Monetary Fund figures setting out Italy's chances of joining Europe's Economic and Monetary Union in 1999, van der Pas said he could not speak for the IMF.
As far as the Commission was concerned, there was no question of pre-selecting which countries would join the European single currency in the first wave, he said.
The Commission was aware of the efforts Italy had made to meet the Maastricht convergence criteria, encouraged it to continue, and thought it possible Rome might make the 1999 deadline, he added.

Van der Pas said talks would continue with the US to resolve a dispute over trade in poultry, although no date had been set, but the EU had not ruled out taking the dispute to the World Trade Organisation.
The EU was also considering appealing against a WTO ruling on Wednesday which declared the EU's banana import regime incompatible with world trade rules, van der Pas said.

He said he did not know whether the Commission had decided to launch an investigation into a proposed joint venture between CocaCola and Carlsberg to bottle and distribute CocaCola products in Scandinavia.
Van der Pas also introduced Eila Nevalainen, who takes over from Timo Personen as spokeswoman for Budget Commissioner Erkki Liikanen.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/377: WTO panel on bananas - Declaration by Commission President Jacques Santer
- IP/97/378: Commission continues its work on the action plan on research into transmissible spongiform encephalopathies
- IP/97/379: State aid, Germany - Commission opens proceedings for aid granted to Triptis Porzellan GmbH, Thueringen
- IP/97/380: State aid, Spain - Commission decides to open a procedure on aid to Porcelanas del Norte S.A.L. PONSAL
- IP/97/381: Commission approves the acquisition by Teneco of the Protective Packaging and Flexible Packaging Divisions of KNP BT
- IP/97/382: Cyprus - Commission grants 2.96-million-ecu subsidy from MEDA programme
- IP/97/383: State aid, Germany - Commission clears four cases in favour of East German companies
- ME/97/2.5: Midday Express
- SPEECH/97/105: Extracts from a sppech by Monkia Wulf-Mathies to close the Cohesion Forum in Brussels (April 30) - "The lessons of the past, pathways to the future"
- SPEECH/97/106: Speech by Padraig Flynn - "Prime time for tolerance: Journalism and the challenge of racism".
